Proposed commercial play:
- Approve temporary 3x headroom for 3 hours (low risk; will be rate-limited by token ceilings afterwards).

Sofia —
We’ve done a few similar moves. Quick answers and a suggested cost/credit math:

1) Precedent: yes, we have granted one-time credits + staged billing for first-time launch overruns (exceptions logged under Sales Exceptions).
2) Numbers: their overage for the 3-hour window is ~1.1M tokens above committed baseline = estimated $3,520 at list.
   - Proposed credit: 30% of that overage = $1,056 credit (applied to Jan invoice).
   - Amortize remaining $2,464 across Feb/Mar = $1,232 each invoice.
3) Temporary uplift: ops can flip a 3x headroom; recommend adding a conservative kill-switch at +6x to prevent runaway.
4) Escrowed buffer: offer a $5k prepaid burst buffer that converts dollar-for-dollar to usage; discount 10% if they commit at PO (helps sticky revenue).

I’m attaching the calc sheet I cleaned up. If you want, I can authorize the credit and prep the one-off invoice adjustment (billing@redwood.ai) if Legal signs off on the addendum wording (I can draft).

—Rishi
